promptText: Which hotel brands should an owner consider when converting an existing upper-upscale hotel asset in Europe?
rawText:
This is a great question with a lot of market activity to draw from. Here is a comprehensive overview of the hotel brands an owner should consider when converting an existing **upper-upscale hotel asset in Europe**, organized by parent company:

---

## 🏨 Upper-Upscale Hotel Brand Conversions in Europe: An Owner's Guide

The European hotel conversion market is booming. 
Combined hotel renovations and brand conversions in Europe at the end of Q4 2025 total 700 projects/90,066 rooms.
 
Particularly in Europe, conversions represented around 84% of openings and 71% of signings in 2025.
 This makes the continent arguably the world's most active market for hotel rebranding, giving owners strong negotiating leverage and a wide menu of brand options.

Below are the key brands to consider, grouped by franchisor:

---

### 1. 🔵 IHG Hotels & Resorts

IHG has arguably the most aggressive conversion strategy in Europe right now, with multiple brands targeting the upper-upscale segment.

#### **voco Hotels** *(Premium/Upper-Upscale)*

Working with high-quality individual and locally branded hotels, voco offers owners the ability to drive higher returns through a compelling guest experience and IHG's powerful systems, including best-in-class revenue management, technology capabilities, and the IHG Rewards Club loyalty programme.
 
Recognised as the World's Leading Premium Hotel Brand at the 2025 World Travel Awards, voco shows owners aren't just choosing speed — they're choosing performance.


#### **Noted Collection** *(New Upper-Upscale Soft Brand — EMEAA Focus)*

Noted Collection is IHG's 21st brand, sitting alongside Crowne Plaza, voco, and Ruby in the group's premium portfolio. The soft brand focuses primarily on conversions in the upscale and upper upscale segments and will initially roll out in the Europe, Middle East, Asia and Africa (EMEAA) region.
 
The group is targeting more than 150 Noted Collection hotels globally in the next decade.
 Crucially, 
the Noted brand "fills a key space in our brand ladder" and brings growth potential in the "critically important premium segment."


#### **Vignette Collection** *(Luxury & Lifestyle Soft Brand)*

Vignette Collection welcomes independent luxury and lifestyle hotels seeking distinct style and character while benefitting from IHG's global enterprise.
 This is the right choice for owners who want the lightest brand touch at a higher price point.

#### **Crowne Plaza** *(Classic Upper-Upscale Hard Brand)*
For owners who want a well-established, full-service upper-upscale hard brand with strong corporate travel appeal, Crowne Plaza remains a staple in IHG's European portfolio and is a proven conversion target.

---

### 2. 🔴 Marriott International


Conversion and reconversion projects are the most prolific, accounting for half of the projects signed by Marriott last year, and this momentum benefits the group's collector brands, notably Autograph and Tribute.


#### **Autograph Collection** *(Upper-Upscale/Luxury Soft Brand)*

Autograph Collection is Marriott's premium soft brand, often thought of as the little sister to Marriott's luxury soft brand, The Luxury Collection. It straddles the line between Marriott's premium/upper-upscale and luxury hotels.
 
These hotels are curated for guests who want forward-thinking experiences, as well as design-crafted spaces — each offering an original aesthetic, attention to detail, and a boutique experience for travelers.


#### **Tribute Portfolio** *(Upper-Upscale Soft Brand)*

Tribute Portfolio is made up of hotels for independent and spirited business and leisure travelers. These are hotels with character — defined by striking design elements, bold color, and art installations.
 
The collection is viewed as a competitor of the Curio Collection and Preferred Hotels & Resorts.


#### **Renaissance Hotels** *(Upper-Upscale Hard Brand)*
For owners seeking a full-service upper-upscale hard brand with a strong business-traveler base, Renaissance Hotels offer a more structured conversion path within Marriott's portfolio, with global distribution through Marriott Bonvoy.

#### **Le Méridien** *(Upper-Upscale Hard Brand)*

Marriott's Le Méridien brand is a design-centred line of European-inspired hotels, targeting creative, cosmopolitan travelers.
 This brand has natural appeal in European city settings and suits properties with a cultural or design-forward identity.

---

### 3. 🟡 Hilton Worldwide

#### **Curio Collection by Hilton** *(Upper-Upscale Soft Brand)*

Curio Collection is known for its portfolio of historic, distinctive four- and five-star hotels. The brand targets open-minded travelers — both business travelers and vacation-goers — who want the experience of an independent hotel and the level of service expected from an upscale Hilton.


#### **Hilton Hotels & Resorts** *(Upper-Upscale Hard Brand)*

Hilton Hotels & Resorts is positioned as an upper-upscale brand within Hilton's broader portfolio of more than 24 distinct brands.
 This flagship brand is ideal for larger, full-service assets in primary European gateway cities.

#### **DoubleTree by Hilton** *(Upper-Upscale/Upscale Conversion Brand)*
DoubleTree is one of Hilton's most conversion-friendly brands and is deeply established across Europe. It suits full-service hotels in secondary cities or suburban locations where the Hilton or Curio brands may not be the right fit.

---

### 4. 🟠 Hyatt Hotels Corporation

#### **Hyatt Regency** *(Upper-Upscale Hard Brand)*
Hyatt Regency is a strong conversion option for larger European assets. 
For example, the Hotel International Hamburg will undergo a renovation before relaunching late in 2026 as Hyatt Regency Hamburg Hafencity.


#### **Unbound Collection by Hyatt** *(Upper-Upscale/Luxury Soft Brand)*

The Unbound Collection is Hyatt's version of Autograph by Marriott or Curio by Hilton — a luxury and upper upscale full-service soft brand. Hotels have a measure of independence with full access to the Hyatt distribution network and resources. It's become a smart home for standout independents that need global distribution.


#### **me and all hotels** *(Upscale Lifestyle — Europe-Specific)*

Hyatt acquired the me and all hotels brand to unlock growth in new European markets and build on Hyatt's strong momentum in the region.
 This is a compelling option for lifestyle-oriented upper-upscale assets in urban European locations.

---

### 5. 🟣 Radisson Hotel Group

#### **Radisson Blu** *(Upper-Upscale Hard Brand)*

Radisson Blu has been the largest upper upscale hotel brand in Europe for 13 years, delivering meaningful and memorable experiences in stylish spaces. These hotels are in major cities and key airport gateways as well as leisure destinations, catering for both the business traveller and leisure guests.


#### **Radisson RED** *(Upper-Upscale Lifestyle Brand)*

Radisson RED is an upper upscale brand with a more playful, lifestyle attitude, creating Instagrammable experiences for its guests — able to switch effortlessly between business and pleasure, injecting new life into hospitality in vibrant surroundings.
 This brand suits younger-skewing assets and vibrant city-centre locations.


These hotels have set new benchmarks for conversion-led sustainability, reinforcing the Group's commitment to reducing environmental impact and future-proofing owner assets.


---

### 6. 🔶 Accor

#### **MGallery** *(Upper-Upscale/Lifestyle Soft Brand)*
MGallery is Accor's boutique upper-upscale soft brand, designed for unique, story-driven hotels. It is particularly strong in European leisure destinations and culturally rich city centres, offering access to Accor's ALL loyalty program.

#### **Emblems Collection & Handwritten Collection** *(Soft Brands)*

Accor offers the Handwritten and Emblems brands
 as soft brand options for independent-minded upper-upscale hotel owners who want affiliation without heavy brand standardization.

---

### 7. ⚪ Minor Hotels (New Entrant)


Minor Reserve Collection is a new luxury soft brand for independent hotels with strong character and identity, with projects already announced in Europe and South America. Colbert Collection is Minor's new upscale soft brand, giving owners access to its distribution, loyalty platform, and management expertise while allowing greater flexibility around the property itself.


---

## 📊 Key Takeaways for Owners

| Brand | Parent | Type | Best Fit |
|---|---|---|---|
| **voco** | IHG | Soft/Hard | Versatile urban/leisure conversions |
| **Noted Collection** | IHG | Soft | Unique, character-driven properties (EMEAA focus) |
| **Vignette Collection** | IHG | Soft | Lifestyle/luxury conversions |
| **Autograph Collection** | Marriott | Soft | Distinctive, independent-spirited hotels |
| **Tribute Portfolio** | Marriott | Soft | Design-forward, character-rich hotels |
| **Renaissance** | Marriott | Hard | Full-service business/leisure assets |
| **Curio Collection** | Hilton | Soft | Historic, distinctive 4-5 star properties |
| **Hilton Hotels & Resorts** | Hilton | Hard | Major gateway city full-service hotels |
| **Unbound Collection** | Hyatt | Soft | Standout independents needing global reach |
| **Hyatt Regency** | Hyatt | Hard | Larger, full-service convention-oriented hotels |
| **Radisson Blu** | Radisson | Hard | Established European city/airport hotels |
| **Radisson RED** | Radisson | Soft/Hard | Lifestyle-oriented urban hotels |
| **MGallery** | Accor | Soft | Boutique, story-driven leisure hotels |
| **Colbert Collection** | Minor Hotels | Soft | Flexible, character-driven conversions |


Branded conversions can be particularly powerful when distribution, loyalty, and global scale help broaden demand, strengthen visibility, and unlock new performance opportunities — though independence can also be a compelling route for hotels with a loyal customer base, distinctive positioning, and strong operational capability.
 Owners should weigh the **fee structure, PIP (Property Improvement Plan) requirements, loyalty program strength, and brand fit** for their specific asset before committing to any one flag.
